# Microsoft Windows components

The native application uses Windows system APIs, including Media Foundation,
from the installed operating system. WebView2 is neither used nor bundled.

The unmodified Visual C++ CRT x64 DLLs are redistributed from the
Microsoft.VC143.CRT redistributable directory supplied with Visual Studio.
Their Microsoft distribution terms continue to apply.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files
https://aka.ms/vs/17/redist.txt

These notices grant no additional rights in transcription models or weights.
